biography:
The Matt Berry Trio is a UK acid jazz ensemble featuring Matt Berry alongside long-time collaborators Phill Scragg and Graham Mann, marking the first album release under this trio name. The group was formed to contribute to Acid Jazz Records’ The Jazz Sessions series, delivering their debut album Everything’s Peachy, which was released on June 26, 2026, across multiple formats including black vinyl, a limited green vinyl exclusive to the Acid Jazz store, CD, digital download, and streaming platforms. The album is a 12-part instrumental suite that explores Berry’s diverse influences in jazz, modern classical, and electronic music, showcasing the trio’s tight interplay and experimental spirit.

Everything’s Peachy serves as the second volume in The Jazz Sessions series, following the successful debut Soul Drums by The Steve White Trio, and highlights the Matt Berry Trio’s unique position within the acid jazz scene. The project reflects Matt Berry’s decade-long association with Acid Jazz Records, a partnership that has seen him evolve into an extraordinary musician with a career spanning diverse musical adventures. With Everything’s Peachy, the trio not only continues Berry’s legacy but also introduces a fresh, instrumental dimension to his artistic output, appealing to fans of both his earlier work and the broader acid jazz genre.

The Matt Berry Trio’s sound is characterized by its intricate instrumental arrangements and Berry’s distinctive guitar work, which anchors the trio’s dynamic interplay with Scragg and Mann. Their music draws inspiration from a wide range of sources, including modern classical compositions and electronic textures, creating a rich and layered sonic experience that defines their contribution to the acid jazz movement. As the first album from the Matt Berry Trio, Everything’s Peachy establishes the group as a significant force in contemporary UK acid jazz, blending tradition with innovation in a way that resonates with both longtime fans and new listeners.
